author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Good morning mooers! Here are things you need to know about today's market:
US Stocks Mixed as Rate Cut Odds Dip
Malaysian Market Dips Despite Positive GDP Growth
Stocks to watch: CDB, GENM and etc.
- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
$S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ 6,449.80（-0.29%)
$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ 44,946.12 (+0.08%)
$Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ 21,622.98 (-0.40%)
US stocks closed mixed Friday as September rate cut odds dipped and tech stocks weakened slightly. The $S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ closed down 0.29% at 6,449.80, while the $Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ slipped 0.40% to 21,622.98 and the $Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ rose 0.08% to 44,946.12.
However, Marc Sumerlin, a potential candidate to replace Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, argued on "Bloomberg Surveillance" that the current Fed funds rate is "too high." He suggested that a 50 basis point cut would be effective, citing the inversion of the yield curve as justification.
$Applied Materials (AMAT.US)$ reacted negatively to its financial results announced after the close of trading the previous day, and other semiconductor-related stocks also performed poorly. $NVIDIA (NVDA.US)$ fell 0.86%, $Broadcom (AVGO.US)$ fell 1.57%, $Palantir (PLTR.US)$ fell 2.13%. But $UnitedHealth (UNH.US)$ surged after Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway significantly increased its stake in the company.
Additionally, President Donald Trump has indicated that tariffs on some imported goods could increase to as high as 300%. He specifically mentioned plans for a 100% tax on semiconductor imports, with exemptions for companies that move their manufacturing to the U.S.
Bursa Market Insight
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$1576.34 (-0.30%)
Top Gainer: $MRDIY (5296.MY)$ RM1.560 (+1.30%)
Top Loser: $PCHEM (5183.MY)$ RM3.560 (-2.20%)
USD/MYR: $USD/MYR (USDMYR.FX)$ 4.2130 (+0.01%)
Bursa Malaysia closed lower on Friday, with the $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ dropping 4.71 points (0.30%) to 1,576.34, despite positive sentiment from Malaysia's Q2 2025 GDP release. Trading volume decreased to 2.01 billion units worth RM2.03 billion, down from the previous day's 2.40 billion units valued at RM2.66 billion. The broader market saw decliners outnumbering advancers 488 to 449.
Malaysia's second-quarter 2025 GDP expanded by 4.4% year-on-year has exceeded expectations. This growth occurred despite concerns over reciprocal tariffs announced and ongoing trade policy uncertainty between the United States and other nations.
After experiencing net foreign fund outflows of RM5.4 billion and RM5.5 billion in June and July respectively, Malaysia's bond market is expected to see renewed interest from foreign investors in the coming months. This anticipated shift is attributed to several factors: reduced tariffs on Malaysian exports to the United States from 25% to 19%, a 90-day extension of the US-China tariff truce, and potential interest rate cuts by the US Federal Reserve.
Stocks to Watch $CDB (6947.MY)$, $MAXIS (6012.MY)$, and $YTLPOWR (6742.MY)$ have each provided an additional RM116.67 million to Digital Nasional Bhd (DNB), bringing their total investments to RM350.03 million each. This move supports DNB's 5G network operations as Malaysia transitions to a dual 5G network model.
$GENM (4715.MY)$ is restructuring its struggling US unit, Empire Resorts Inc, through a RM2.2 billion asset sale. Empire Resorts will sell key non-casino properties, including the Resorts World Catskills and Alder Hotel, to Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation.
$VANTNRG (5218.MY)$, formerly Sapura Energy, has signed a deal with Malaysia Development Holding for an up to RM1.1 billion cash injection. This agreement is crucial for Vantris' restructuring plan, which must take effect by March 11, 2026.
$IJM (3336.MY)$ has won a RM1.4 billion contract to build a large-scale data centre in Johor Bahru, marking its largest data centre project to date. The fast-track contract involves constructing a six-storey facility with integrated office spaces and a refuse and recycling facility.
$AFFIN (5185.MY)$'s net profit rose by over 21% in the second quarter of 2025, reaching RM143.5 million. The growth was driven by stronger interest and non-interest income, with net interest income up 11% to RM212.76 million and non-interest income surging 30% to RM184.67 million.
$HEIM (3255.MY)$ reported an 8.93% decrease in net profit for Q2 2025, with earnings falling to RM83 million from RM91.13 million a year earlier. Revenue also declined by 5% to RM539.73 million. Despite the downturn, the company declared a single-tier interim dividend of 40 sen per share.
$SDS (0212.MY)$ is expanding its operations by acquiring factories and production lines from Mamee Bakery Sdn Bhd in Plentong, Johor for RM28 million. The acquisition includes full production lines for various baked goods, including Swiss rolls and cakes.

author: 旋风小肥侠
body: The outlook for Genting over the next three months appears cautiously optimistic, while also accompanied by certain risks that warrant attention. Core Business Outlook In the coming three months, Genting's core business drivers are expected to primarily stem from its leisure and hospitality segment, which contributes over 80% of the group's revenue. The ongoing recovery of the global tourism industry, particularly the enhanced airline connectivity in the Asia-Pacific region and the relaxation of visa policies (such as the easing of visa restrictions between China and Singapore), will continue to drive visitor traffic to Resorts World Genting (RWG) and Resorts World Sentosa (RWS). Notably, Genting Singapore intends to construct an integrated resort in the UAE, which could also serve as a potential catalyst for market sentiment. The plantation business benefits from stable palm oil prices and increased production, and is expected to maintain strong performance, providing support to the group's overall results. The power sector may also remain robust against the backdrop of rising demand in Asia, but attention should be paid to the long-term impacts of the transition to renewable energy. This suggests that future dividend payouts may be under pressure. Potential Investment Risks Investing in Genting also requires attention to the following risks: 1. Exchange Rate and Geopolitical Risks: Genting operates across multiple countries, and its performance is susceptible to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates (particularly the USD/MYR exchange rate) and global geopolitical conflicts. 2. Legal and Regulatory Risks: Although lawsuits in the United States have largely concluded, the group still faces other legal challenges (such as the Bahamas case). Any adverse rulings could lead to financial and reputational losses. 3. Market Competition and Cost Pressures: The leisure and gaming industry is highly competitive. Additionally, rising operating costs, interest expenses, and depreciation costs may compress profit margins. 4. Seasonal Fluctuations: The fourth quarter is traditionally a low season for the leisure tourism industry, during which there have historically been significant performance declines. Attention should be paid to the potential recurrence of such seasonal fluctuations over the next three months. Key Focus Points for the Next Three Months In the next three months, the following aspects can be closely monitored: · Recovery trend of tourism: Focus on the number of tourists in Malaysia, Singapore, and the United States, particularly the recovery of Chinese tourists, which directly impacts the revenue of Genting's core business. · Progress of important projects: Monitor the upgrade progress of Genting Singapore's RWS 2.0, the effectiveness of the 60th anniversary celebration activities, as well as the advancement of new projects in the plantation and oil and gas sectors (such as the FLNG facility in the Kasuri block in Indonesia). · Updates on financial statements: Pay attention to the next quarterly report regarding revenue growth, adjusted EBITDA margins, and cash flow status. · Analyst opinions and market sentiment: Track whether analytical agencies have new ratings or target price adjustment reports. Investment Recommendation Overall, Genting is in a phase of both recovery and challenges over the next three months. · For short-term investors, the stock price's response to favorable factors for tourism recovery, changes in market sentiment, and technical levels may be the focus. However, caution should be exercised regarding seasonal off-peak periods and potential market volatility risks. For long-term investors, Genting's diversified business structure (including leisure, agriculture, and power) provides a certain degree of risk resilience. Although the current valuation lags behind the market index, it does not seem to fully reflect all of its recovery potential and asset value (such as the potential of its pharmaceutical company TauRx, which is underestimated by the market). Long-term investments should pay more attention to the ongoing recovery of its various business segments, the return on investment for new projects, and the group's overall debt management and cash flow generation capabilities. title: The issuance of municipal bonds has been postponed, and the sale of non-gaming assets by Genting New York may undergo changes.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
(New York, 27th) Bloomberg reports, citing sources, that the issuance of high-yield municipal bonds intended for the acquisition of Genting New York's casino-related business has been postponed. This unrated transaction was originally scheduled for pricing on August 27, led by KeyBanc Capital Markets. However, informed sources revealed that the transaction was delayed due to investors needing to hire legal advisors for independent opinions, a move referred to in the market as 'hiring buyer's counsel'. The bond issuer is the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corp, a nonprofit organization established under the New York State Economic Development Law. The proceeds from the bond issuance are expected to be used to acquire Genting Malaysia. $GENM (4715.MY)$ The non-gaming businesses under Empire Resorts, a subsidiary of Genting Malaysia, include the Resorts World Catskills. Currently, the transaction is listed as 'day-to-day status' in the market, meaning it may be restarted at any time. KeyBanc and the development corporation both declined to comment. Genting Malaysia is also tight-lipped on the matter. Restructuring of Empire Resorts' assets. As early as the 15th of this month, in order to improve its capital structure and financial performance, Empire Resorts announced a significant asset restructuring plan, which includes the divestiture of non-gaming assets for $525 million (approximately 2.2 billion Malaysian Ringgit) and the redemption of bonds. The company noted that this move will yield three benefits: first, it will eliminate debt and interest expenses, optimizing the capital structure; second, it will secure full ownership of the land, enhancing the asset base and development potential; third, it will reduce rental expenses, improving long-term financial performance, and is expected to free up approximately $10 million (about 42.1 million Malaysian Ringgit) as working capital. Genting Malaysia emphasizes that this plan will strengthen the company's competitive position in the gaming market in New York and the Northeast United States, laying a foundation for future growth.
Source: Nanyang Siang Pau

title: It is no surprise that stock traders are confused, as Malaysian Chinese media themselves cannot clearly distinguish between GENTING and GENM.
author: 风起云涌LBF
body:
Note the code ~ Genting GENTING, 3182 is a parent company that holds multiple listed companies (Genting Plantations GENP listed in Malaysia ~ Genting Malaysia GENM listed in Malaysia ~ Genting Singapore GENSP listed in Singapore ~ Genting USA Las Vegas (not listed)).

Currently, GENM, code 4715, is involved in the tumultuous consolidation of casinos in New York, selling non-gaming business properties and bidding for three FULL gaming licenses in southern New York by the end of the year (also holding Genting Philippines Casino ~ Genting UK Casino ~ Genting USA casinos in other regions).

As the parent company of the aforementioned entities, GENTING's financial report today includes GENP Genting Plantations. The previous reports from Genting Singapore (GENSP) and Genting Las Vegas have directly influenced the overall financial report released on Friday. Meanwhile, Genting Malaysia (GENM), which released its report alongside GENTING, constitutes only a portion of its main revenue.

If you seek a safe balance, choose the parent stock GENTING, 3182 (mutual impact). If you are aiming for good news regarding the New York gaming license by year-end, focus on GENM, 4715*.

🏆 Why Genting Malaysia Is a Strong Contender
- Existing Footprint: Genting already operates Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) in Queens, a video lottery terminal facility. Its plan is to upgrade RWNYC into a full-scale integrated resort.
- Massive Investment: Genting has proposed a US$5.5 billion expansion, signaling deep commitment and financial capability.
- Tax Contributions: RWNYC contributed over US$600 million in taxes last year, and Genting projects this could rise to US$1 billion annually if granted a full license.
- Community Support & Zoning: RWNYC’s existing operations give it a leg up in meeting local approval requirements.

🎰 Why MGM Is Also a Favorite
- Empire City Casino: MGM operates this facility in Yonkers, which—like RWNYC—is currently limited to electronic games. MGM aims to convert it into a full-scale casino.
- Natural Advantage: Analysts believe Empire City and RWNYC have a “natural advantage” due to their established presence and community ties.
- Economic Impact: MGM’s proposal emphasizes job creation, capital investment, and maximizing state revenue—all key criteria for license selection.

⚔️ Competitive Landscape
While Genting and MGM are favored, they face stiff competition from:
- Las Vegas Sands
- Wynn Resorts
- Hard Rock (partnered with Steve Cohen)

The final decision hinges on economic impact, community support, and proposed amenities. With three licenses available, Genting and MGM’s existing infrastructure and local ties make them strong bets—but nothing’s guaranteed until the official announcement.

body:
His fundamental range is approximately RM3. If the group's 'underlying value' is considered to be stable business + existing asset value (Genting Malaysia + Genting Singapore + Energy + Plantations), then the stock price in the RM3–3.3 range can be understood as the 'asset value floor.' In a favorable scenario (U.S. license approval + improvement in investor sentiment): RM4.00 is reasonable. As for if the U.S. operations successfully materialize + profits rebound, then RM5.00–6.00 could be possible. However, I do not recommend betting on this, as the risks are too high.
Finance and Dividends The lack of dividend distribution may continue, as the company requires funds to support expansion and debt. Long-term investors lack return attractiveness → Insufficient support for stock prices. Business Outlook Increased Regulation of the Gaming Industry: Uncertainty Surrounds License Applications in the U.S.; if unsuccessful, it could jeopardize the most significant growth narrative. Reliance on a Single Industry: The casino's revenue share is excessively high and is significantly influenced by economic and policy cycles. Global Economic Instability: A decrease in tourists would directly impact the business of resorts and casinos. Summary: Genting may fall into a situation of 'high investment, low return' in the coming years. Without stable dividends, business expansion comes with high risks, lacking the appeal for long-term capital. → Not suitable for conservative investors; it is more of a high-risk speculative stock. If you are looking to earn dividends, Genting is definitely not the best choice.

title: Looking at 1,605 points in terms of the overall index target, Malaysian stocks led the five major investment themes in the final quarter
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Based on the overall index target, 1605 points Top 5 investment themes for Malaysian stocks in the final quarter
Following the fiscal year 2025 results season, CIMB raised the ratings of some Sector. At the same time, it believes that with improved domestic liquidity, lower interest rates, and a relatively stable political environment, the investment opportunities for Malaysian stocks at the end of the second half of the year can be summarized into five core themes. Currently, analysts have raised the rating of the Malaysian Planting Industry from “neutral” to “increase holdings.” The main reasons include SD dental straightening $SDG (5285.MY)$In the first half of the year, it surpassed expectations, improved palm oil price prospects, and cooperated with Financial Services $GAMUDA (5398.MY)$Jointly develop solar energy projects and strengthen their renewable energy layout. Analysts also maintain an “bullish” stance on building materials, construction, Medical, telecommunications, and utilities. ==== The five core investment themes for Malaysian stocks in the final quarter: ●Theme 1: Resilience in domestic demand In the second half of this year, the government's one-time payment of RM100 Mercy Basic Assistance Fund (SARA) became a key support. This amount of Cash/Money Market was distributed from August 31 to December 31, bringing the total amount of SARA and Mercy Assistance Fund (STR) for the whole year to RM15 billion. Direct funding to low- and middle-income cohort is expected to translate into stronger consumption of daily necessities. Looking ahead, with the straightening of the RON95 RBOB Gasoline subsidy, the government is likely to submit the 2026 budget in October to further strengthen SARA efforts to hedge against rising oil prices, thus continuing consumption momentum. In terms of beneficiary stocks, 99 Speed Mart $99SMART (5326.MY)$It is regarded as the most direct beneficiary due to its nationwide network of stores. AEON $AEON (6599.MY)$with Mr.diy $MRDIY (5296.MY)$, it is expected to benefit from weak consumption and demand for daily necessities, while Farm Fresh$FFB (5306.MY)$With a wide range of retail channels and new product launches, it is also possible to lock in necessary consumption growth. ●Theme 2:2026 Malaysian Tourism Year 2026 will be an important milestone for the Malaysian tourism industry. The government has set an ambitious target of 35.6 million visitors and RM147.1 billion in tourism revenue. The strategy focuses on creating demand, increasing passenger flow, and targeting the target market. This will directly benefit the leisure, retail and medical tourism sectors. Genting $GENTING (3182.MY)$With Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$It is expected to welcome more gamblers and visitors, and theme parks will be the center of traffic. Sunway $SUNWAY (5211.MY)$With Sunway $SUNREIT (5176.MY)$With the advantage of integrating retail malls, hotels and leisure facilities, it is expected to amplify travel dividends. In terms of medical tourism sector, Johor Healthcare $KPJ (5878.MY)$with IHH Medical Group $IHH (5225.MY)$They were also named potential winners. ●Theme 3: Infrastructure and Industrialization Malaysia's medium-term economic growth path is being supported by multiple policy frameworks, such as the Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR), the Rouxin Special XINJINGJI Zone, the New Industry Blueprint (NIMP 2030), and the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP). These plans are aimed at speeding up industrialization, increasing economic complexity, and strengthening the country's competitiveness. Construction and infrastructure units, including Financial Services University and IJM $IJM (3336.MY)$It will directly benefit from large-scale projects and transportation links. Utilities and energy, there is National Energy $TENAGA (5347.MY)$, Yang Zhongli Electric Power $YTLPOWR (6742.MY)$Demand for electricity is expected to grow due to industrialization, investment in data centers and renewable energy. Logistics and ports, including Westport Holdings $WPRTS (5246.MY)$, with a view to benefiting from the integration of industrial corridors and supply chains. Industry and industrial development, including SD Yajili and Ma Xing Group $MAHSING (8583.MY)$, Sunway, UEM Sunshine$UEMS (5148.MY)$It has the advantage of meeting the needs of industrial parks and comprehensive development. The banking sector, on the other hand, is an indirect beneficiary. Because of its participation in financing and structural design, it can benefit from the multiplier effect. ●Topic 4: Defensive Dividend Strategy In a volatile environment, high dividends have become investors' preferred defensive strategy. The overall dividend ratio of Malaysian stocks reached 4.2%, higher than Indonesia (3.8%), Thailand (4.0%), and only lower than Singapore (4.8%). The banking sector is seen as a sound choice, including Public Bank $PBBANK (1295.MY)$, Hong Leong Bank $HLBANK (5819.MY)$, Societe Generale Bank $RHBBANK (1066.MY)$Bank of India $MAYBANK (1155.MY)$The dividend ratio ranges from 5% to 6%. Telecom stocks such as Tiandi Tong Digital Network $CDB (6947.MY)$, Malaysia Telecom $TM (4863.MY)$, Mingxun $MAXIS (6012.MY)$Cash/Money Market flow is stable, and dividend rate is around 5%. In the planting industry, Daan $TAANN (5012.MY)$It is particularly prominent, with a dividend rate of up to 8%, backed by a net Cash/Money Market balance sheet and a strong dividend policy. Overall, these stocks form a steady “dividend basket”, providing stable returns and Cash/Money Market flow guarantees for defensive investors. ●Theme 5: Return of value Some stocks have been at low valuations for many years due to industry headwinds or short-term profit pressure, but they have strong fundamentals and opportunities for revaluation. Bumi Amada $ARMADA (5210.MY)$Currently, the stock price is only 4 times the capital to profit ratio in fiscal year 2025, 0.3 times the face value of the stock price. The order book reached RM19.8 billion, and the net debt ratio was 21.8%. High-yield product industry $KOSSAN (7153.MY)$The stock price was discounted by 25% against the book value, holding RM1.7 billion in net Cash/Money Market, accounting for 53% of the Market Cap. Net profit is expected to pick up as demand for gloves stabilizes and sales prices bottom out. Horse Resources $MRCB (1651.MY)$The partial valuation was discounted by 72%, and the stock price was only half of the book value. Yongan Group $YOCB (5159.MY)$The 2026 capital-to-profit ratio was only 7.5 times, with a net Cash/Money Market of 0.1 billion 46 million ringgit, accounting for 55% of the Market Cap, and a dividend ratio of 5.3% to 6.2%. These undervalued stocks are all seen as attractive risk-return combinations. ===== Subtext: Raising the Composite Index outlook Analysts pointed out that although net profit performance for the second quarter was moderate, with only 16% of companies exceeding expectations and 29% losing, management guidance for the second half of the year was optimistic, and 20% of companies announced higher dividends. Currently, analysts have lowered the forecast for core net profit growth of the Composite Index for FY2025 from 3.4% to 0.9%, while maintaining 7.5% growth in 2026. However, based on political stability, improved domestic liquidity, and interest rate cuts by the Bank of China, analysts raised the target for the end of 2025 from 1,560 points to 1,605 points, corresponding to 15.3 times the price-earnings ratio. Overall, short-term risks such as the appreciation of the ringgit to suppress overseas revenue, the imposition of tariffs on Malaysia by the US, and the expansion of sales and service taxes have been broadly reflected in the valuation, and the market is expected to usher in a phased revaluation.

title: Daily Stock Talk: Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM, 4715)
author: ShengInvest
body:
Today, let’s take a look at a well-known blue-chip stock in Malaysia’s leisure & tourism sector — Genting Malaysia Berhad ( $GENM (4715.MY)$).
Company Overview
-GENM is one of Southeast Asia’s leading leisure and hospitality groups, operating resorts, casinos, theme parks, and hotels.
-Key assets include:
1.Resorts World Genting (RWG) — Malaysia’s largest integrated resort and casino.
2.Casino operations in the UK and Egypt.
3.Resorts World Casino New York City (RWNYC) in the US, and indirect exposure to Resorts World Las Vegas through the parent company.
-GENM’s revenue is largely driven by tourism and gaming, making it cyclical but highly cash generative.
Financial Performance
-For FY2024, GENM recorded revenue of around RM10.5 billion with net profit of RM1.27 billion, up ~18% year-on-year.
-Recovery was mainly driven by the return of domestic and international tourists, as well as stronger hotel and theme park performance.
-Dividend yield stands around 3.5%–4%, reflecting a consistent payout policy.
Technical Outlook
-GENM’s share price bottomed at RM1.40 in April 2025 and has since rebounded strongly to around RM2.15, a gain of over 50%.
-The stock has broken above its 200-day moving average, establishing a medium-term uptrend.
-Immediate resistance lies at RM2.20–2.25, and if broken, the next target zone could be RM2.40–2.50.
Recent Rebound Drivers
-Attractive Valuation – At its April low, GENM was trading at only ~9–10x P/E, significantly below peers and historical averages, which attracted bargain hunters.
-Earnings Recovery Expectations – The reopening of tourism and strong visitor momentum have lifted optimism on GENM’s profit growth.
-Tourism Boost Policies – Government initiatives (ahead of Visit Malaysia 2026) and a weaker ringgit attracting foreign tourists have provided sector-wide support.
-Technical Breakout – The stock broke through its long-term downtrend, sparking momentum buying from technical traders.
Investment Highlights
-Recovery Theme – Strong beneficiary of Malaysia’s post-pandemic tourism and leisure rebound.
-Dividend Support – Stable cash flow enables regular dividend payments (3.5%–4% yield).
-Reasonable Valuation – Even after the rebound, valuation at ~12–13x P/E remains undemanding compared to regional peers.
Key Risks
-Gaming operations are highly regulated, with risks tied to government policy and licensing.
-Tourism-related earnings remain cyclical and vulnerable to economic slowdowns or external shocks.
-Overseas operations face FX volatility and regulatory uncertainties.
Conclusion
-Genting Malaysia has staged a strong rebound since its April low, driven by valuation, earnings recovery, and positive sector catalysts. While the share price has already advanced significantly, its fundamentals and dividend support suggest the stock still offers medium-to-long term value. Short-term traders should watch the RM2.20–2.25 resistance level closely.
Discussion:
Do you think GENM can break above RM2.20 and head towards RM2.50?
Would you consider holding GENM as a tourism + recovery play for the long term?
Share your thoughts below!
Sheng

title: Malaysia Morning Wrap | Fed Cuts Rates by 0.25% as Expected; Malaysian Manufacturers Hit by US Tariff Sales Drop
author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Good morning mooers! Here are things you need to know about today's market:
Dow Hits Record High After Fed's Expected Rate Cut, While S&P 500 and Nasdaq Slip
KLCI Breaks 1,600, Closes at 1,611 on Financials; Momentum May Extend to 1,620–1,650
US Tariffs and SST Hike Squeeze Malaysian Manufacturers
Selangor Plans Third Port on Carey Island to Drive Long-Term Growth
Stocks to watch: ADVCON, RESINTC, etc.
- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
$S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ 6,600.35（-0.10%)
$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ 46,018.32 (+0.57%)
$Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ 22,261.33 (-0.33%)
The Dow Jones Industrial Average touched a record intraday high of 46,261.95 Wednesday after the Federal Reserve cut its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 4%-4.25%, as expected. However, it later pared gains, closing up 0.6% at 46,018.32, below last week's record close of 46,108.00.
The S&P 500 dipped 0.1% to 6,600.35, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.3% to 22,261.33, though both ended slightly above pre-announcement levels.
As anticipated by Wall Street, the Federal Reserve lowered its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to a 4%-4.25% range during Wednesday's scheduled policy meeting. The Fed's updated forecasts also signaled an additional 50 basis points of rate reductions expected later this year.
Bursa Market Insight
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ 1611.70 (+0.72%)
Top Gainer: $PETDAG (5681.MY)$ RM22.98 (+5.7%)
Top Loser: $TM (4863.MY)$ RM7.00 (-9.44%)
USD/MYR: $USD/MYR (USDMYR.FX)$ 4.1934 (+0.14%)
Bursa Malaysia surged to an intraday peak, closing at 1,611.70, up 11.57 points from last Friday’s 1,600.13, driven by strong buying in financial heavyweights.
The $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ opened at 1,602.22, briefly dipped to 1,599.61, but rallied to breach the key 1,600 level. Gainers outnumbered losers 739 to 409, with turnover rising to 3.13 billion units valued at RM3.16 billion.
Thong Pak Leng from Rakuten Trade noted robust regional market gains, particularly in China and Hong Kong tech stocks, spurred by optimism in U.S. AI developments. He highlighted the FBM KLCI's breakout above 1,600, eyeing a potential climb to 1,620-1,650 if momentum holds.
About 75% of Malaysian exporters report weaker US sales a month after new tariffs, with E&E exemptions softening the blow. An FMM survey says firms are diversifying markets, automating, and repricing while seeking support, including trade promotion and a GST revival. Expanded SST affects 94% of firms and higher power tariffs hit 60%, spurring interest in renewable energy.
Selangor has allocated 1,699.68 hectares on Carey Island for a third port, with 1,011.71 hectares of seabed under PKNS and 687.96 hectares of coastal land owned by Yayasan Selangor.
IPO Scanner
Stocks to Watch
Shih Chao Yuan, $FPI (9172.MY)$'s managing director, bought a 24.5% stake from Wistron Corp for RM71.66 million on September 12, 2025, securing a 6.55% direct and 22.9% indirect stake.
$ADVCON (5281.MY)$ won a RM66.9 million, 16-month earthworks job for Phase 1 of IBTEC in Kulai starting Sept 24, 2025.
$RESINTC (7232.MY)$ secured a US$3.93 million (RM16.5 million) five-month contract to supply HDPE pipes to Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority by February 2026.
$GENM (4715.MY)$ said partner RAV Bahamas filed an amended Florida suit naming Genting Americas, which it will contest as baseless while RAV seeks over US$600 million over Resorts World Bimini’s debt.
$ASIAPAC (4057.MY)$ plans to sell 35.72 hectares of Semenyih land for RM87.69 million cash to fund projects and cut debt, with completion in about three months.
$MKH (6114.MY)$ will sell its China furniture unit, Vast Furniture (Kunshan), for 84 million yuan (RM49.53 million) cash, expecting a RM26.55 million gain.
$REX (9946.MY)$ will sell its Malaysian F&B units for RM40 million cash to MD Darmendran Kunaretnam and refocus on its profitable Indonesian arm.
$HCK (7105.MY)$ entered a JV to develop a 6.87-hectare Cheras site with GDV of about RM600 million, with construction targeted to start within two years.
$SCIENTX (4731.MY)$'s FY2025 net profit fell 2.7% to RM530.8 million as packaging softened, but it plans stronger 2026 launches and declared a six-sen final dividend, totaling 12 sen.
Buy or Sell?

title: BUDI 95 Stabilizes Conventional Vehicle Sales, Divided Views on Electric Vehicle Prospects
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
(Kuala Lumpur, 23rd report) The Malaysian government has finally unveiled the 'Benevolent Governance Prosperity 95 Targeted Fuel Subsidy Mechanism' (referred to as BUDI 95), and various investment banks believe that this will bring moderate benefits to the country's automotive sector, stabilizing short-term vehicle demand.
CIMB Securities analysts noted that the BUDI 95 policy would keep driving costs for the majority of domestic motorists at an affordable level, supporting market demand for mass-market internal combustion engine vehicles such as national brands—Perodua and Proton—as well as entry-level Japanese brand cars.
As for those consuming more than 300 liters of fuel monthly, exceeding the subsidy cap, the analyst believes this may accelerate their transition to hybrid or fully electric vehicles.
CIMB: Gradual Transition to Electric Vehicles
The stabilization of short-term demand, coupled with a possible gradual shift in consumer preference towards energy efficiency and electrification over the long term, should benefit automakers with electric vehicle offerings, such as Proton, Perodua, and Sime Darby. $SIME (4197.MY)$ 。”
The analyst added that Proton has already launched its e.MAS 7 electric vehicle and is preparing to release its second EV by the end of 2025, while Perodua is also expected to introduce its first EV around the same time.
Sime Darby continues to consolidate its leadership position in the premium and luxury electric vehicle market in Malaysia.
Kenanga: Electric Vehicles Become Losers
However, Kenanga Investment Bank analysts hold a different view, stating that BUDI 95 differs from earlier market expectations, benefiting all Malaysian drivers aged 16 and above without income-based differentiation, which might slow the growth of the local electric vehicle market.
The sales of local electric vehicles (EVs) have continued to grow over the past two years, with sales in the first half of this year nearly doubling, marking a year-on-year surge of 91.4%. The main selling point of EVs has been that high-income groups (T10) are expected to be excluded from targeted subsidy mechanisms, and EVs are projected to save 11.4% to 28.3% in annual costs compared to internal combustion engine vehicles.
Moreover, the analyst agreed that BUDI 95 would clear the clouds hanging over the domestic mid-range automobile market, potentially boosting the sales of internal combustion engine vehicles.
Among local automotive stocks, MBM Resources $MBMR (5983.MY)$ holds the largest share in the affordable fuel vehicle market, which is good news for the company, while Perma Auto $BAUTO (5248.MY)$ is also expected to benefit from more optimistic sentiment.
The analyst also noted that the government's provision of exemptions for gig economy workers such as ride-hailing drivers and delivery personnel—providing subsidies for monthly fuel consumption exceeding 300 liters—means companies like Hong Leong Industrial, which sells motorcycles and relies on the gig economy, are anticipated to benefit. $HLIND (3301.MY)$
Nevertheless, the analyst maintained the forecast for total industry volume (TIV) of automobile sales this year at 805,000 units, representing a slight year-on-year decline of 1%, which is higher than the Malaysian Automotive Association’s prediction of 780,000 units.
Monthly savings of MYR 18 provide slight benefits to the consumer sector.
Regarding the consumer sector, analysts at CIMB Securities pointed out that the introduction of BUDI 95 could bring modest positive impacts to the consumer sector.
Assuming consumers fully utilize the 300-liter subsidized petrol quota each month, they are expected to save up to MYR 18 per month. Although this amount may seem modest, it still increases consumers' disposable income, which can be spent on essential goods, thereby boosting consumption in the short term within the consumer staples and value retail sectors.
Among the consumer stocks tracked by the analyst, she believes that 99 Speed Mart $99SMART (5326.MY)$ , Mr. DIY $MRDIY (5296.MY)$ and Mynews Holdings $MYNEWS (5275.MY)$ will directly benefit.
Additionally, Nestlé $NESTLE (4707.MY)$ and Fraser and Neave $F&N (3689.MY)$ Qianli Resources $QL (7084.MY)$ , and Farm Fresh $FFB (5306.MY)$ are also expected to benefit from increased demand for key food products.
As for consumer stocks beyond necessities, the analyst noted that they may all receive indirect benefits, including Berjaya Corporation $PADINI (7052.MY)$ , AEON $AEON (6599.MY)$ , Wing On Group $YOCB (5159.MY)$ , Boustead Projects $BONIA (9288.MY)$ , Success Food $BJFOOD (5196.MY)$ , and 7-11 Holdings $SEM (5250.MY)$。
Petronas Dagangan is not significantly impacted, while Genting Highlands stands to benefit indirectly.
On the other hand, the analyst pointed out that although the price of RON 95 gasoline has decreased, for Petronas Dagangan $PETDAG (5681.MY)$this is actually a positive development, but it is not expected to significantly affect its retail gasoline sales.
Domestically, gasoline demand is inherently quite inelastic. Historical data shows that even with a 10% to 12% drop in oil prices, the increase in gasoline sales volume is less than 1%.
In terms of operations, the analyst believes that the requirement to verify identity using a MyKad during refueling will not pose significant execution risks for Petronas Dagangan Berhad (PDB), as the company already has the necessary hardware infrastructure in place.
The BUDI 95 system utilizes the existing identity verification system, along with electronic payment platforms such as Petronas' Setel mobile app, which should ensure smooth and effective implementation of the relevant policies.
Furthermore, the analyst noted that with RON 95 gasoline experiencing a slight price reduction to RM1.99 per liter, this may, to a certain extent, encourage more tourists to drive to Genting Highlands, benefiting Genting Malaysia, $GENM (4715.MY)$ although the overall impact is expected to be modest.

title: Good News in New York Casino Bid: Genting Reaches Final Selection, Decision by End of Year
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Cloud Top$GENTING (3182.MY)$ Good news has arrived for the bidding plan for casino licenses in Downstate New York, with two companies becoming the first to gain the support of local community advisory board votes, and their proposals will now proceed to the state government for final review. According to a Bloomberg report, Genting's $5.5 billion (approximately RM23.16 billion) Queens casino resort expansion plan and MGM Resorts International’s $2.3 billion (approximately RM9.69 billion) Empire City Casino expansion proposal have become the first two bids to receive voting support from New York’s local community advisory boards. Final Decision on December 1 The New York Gaming Facility Location Board will review the bids from Genting and MGM and make a final decision on December 1 this year. Since both proposals involve expansions of existing casinos and already have established engagement with local communities, they possess greater flexibility compared to entirely new casino developments and face less opposition. Genting, through its subsidiary Genting New York under Genting Malaysia (GENM, 4715, Main Market Consumer Stock), is participating in the multi-year casino license bidding process in Downstate New York. Genting plans to significantly expand its casino resort located next to the Aqueduct Racetrack, adding 2,000 hotel rooms, an arena, and more than 30 restaurants and bars. Creation of 5,000 Job Opportunities (Subtitle) Genting claims that the resort will create up to 5,000 permanent jobs. Genting, which already operates a casino in the Catskills, also stated that if the company wins the new casino license, the New York State government can begin generating revenue from the additional gaming tables and slot machines within six months. Genting stated that by 2027, the gambling revenue of the new casino is expected to more than double to USD 2.2 billion annually (approximately MYR 9.26 billion). Regarding support for local communities, Robert DeSalvio, President of Genting Americas East, stated: 'This support and vote demonstrate the mission we have consistently upheld over the past 15 years—to be the best neighbor in Queens.' The New York State government plans to issue up to three new casino licenses in this round of bidding. Three Other Proposals Under Evaluation Bloomberg reported that last week, three proposals to build casinos in Manhattan were rejected by local communities. These plans were proposed by SL Green Realty, Silverstein Properties, and the Soloviev Group, respectively. In addition, three other bidding proposals are awaiting evaluation by the Community Advisory Committee, including Bally's project in the Bronx, a project in Coney Island, and a proposal by Steve Cohen, owner of the New York Mets, for a casino at Citi Field in Queens. In any case, the Coney Island project faces widespread opposition from local legislators and has a lower chance of passing through a vote.

According to a Bloomberg report, Genting’s $5.5 billion (approximately RM23.16 billion) Queens casino resort expansion plan and MGM Resorts International’s $2.3 billion (approximately RM9.69 billion) Empire City Casino expansion project are the first two bids to receive voting support from New York’s local community advisory board.
"The New York Gaming Facility Location Board will review the bidding plans of Genting and MGM, and will make a final decision on December 1 of this year."

Since the two proposals mentioned above are expansions of existing casinos and already have a foundation for interaction with the local community, they are more flexible compared to entirely new casino development plans, and face less opposition.

title: The New York State Gaming Facility Location Board is evaluating four finalists for the three available downstate casino licenses, with recommendations expected
author: Tranquility
body:
The New York State Gaming Facility Location Board is evaluating four finalists for the three available downstate casino licenses, with recommendations expected by December 1, 2025, and final approvals by the end of the year. Based on analyses emphasizing economic impact, quick rollout potential, existing infrastructure, revenue projections, and minimal opposition, the likely successful candidates are Resorts World New York City, MGM Empire City, and Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Metropolitan Park. Bally's New York Casino faces the greatest risk of elimination due to a dissenting community advisory vote over perceived insufficient economic investment, a longer development timeline, and political complications involving a $115 million payout to the Trump Organization tied to prior land ownership. ### 1. Resorts World New York City (Queens) - **Developer**: Genting Group. - **Key Strengths**: Expansion of an existing racino at Aqueduct Racetrack, enabling the fastest potential launch (operations could begin within months). Projected $5.5 billion investment and $2.2 billion annual revenue, with strong community support and low opposition. ### 2. MGM Empire City (Yonkers) - **Developer**: MGM Resorts. - **Key Strengths**: Upgrade to an existing casino and racetrack, supporting a rapid expansion. Least opposition among finalists, established revenue streams, and a $1.8 billion investment promising $1.4 billion annual revenue. ### 3. Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Metropolitan Park (Queens) - **Developer**: Steve Cohen (New York Mets owner) and Hard Rock International. - **Key Strengths**: Highest projected revenue ($6.4 billion investment, $3.9 billion annual by year three) and aggressive lobbying ($1.8 million spent in 2024). Despite public opposition from local groups, it received unanimous community advisory approval and aligns with economic benefit priorities.
Let's us keep our fingers crossed & observe how a vibrant democratic & law abiding country works. Most important is to see whether "it bikin & cakap serupa" or not.

Good morning mooers! Here are things you need to know about today's market:
U.S. Stocks Rally as Trade Tensions Ease; Gold and Silver Hit Record Highs
Malaysian Stocks Dip Amid Renewed US-China Trade Tensions
Malaysia Expands Tech Partnerships, Aims to Diversify Global Trade Relations
Stocks to watch: Genting, GenM, etc.
- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
$S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ 6,654.72（+1.56%)
$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ 46,067.58 (+1.29%)
$Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ 22,694.61 (+2.21%)
Wall Street rebounded strongly on Monday, with the Nasdaq Composite jumping 2.2%, while the S&P 500 and Dow Jones gained over 1% each. The rally came as US-China trade tensions, which sparked Friday's sell-off, appeared to subside following President Trump's softer stance over the weekend.
Meanwhile, gold and silver prices soared to record highs amid the ongoing US government shutdown and expectations of potential Federal Reserve rate cuts. Gold futures reached $4,137.20 per ounce, while silver hit $50.625. In tech news, $Broadcom (AVGO.US)$ shares surged 9.9% after announcing a partnership with OpenAI to develop AI accelerators, though it remains unclear if this is related to the previously disclosed $10 billion customer agreement.
Bursa Market Insight
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ 1622.250 (-0.46%)
Top Gainer: $MISC (3816.MY)$ RM7.40 (+1.37%)
Top Loser: $MRDIY (5296.MY)$ RM1.66 (-2.35%)
USD/MYR: $USD/MYR (USDMYR.FX)$ 4.2228(-0.05%)
Bursa Malaysia closed lower on Monday, mirroring regional market declines as US-China trade concerns resurfaced. The FBM KLCI fell 0.43% to 1,615.19 points, with decliners outnumbering gainers by more than two to one.
Market sentiment soured after US President Donald Trump announced plans for new tariffs on Chinese exports, responding to China's recent restrictions on critical mineral exports. The broader market saw increased trading volume, with 3.57 billion shares changing hands, valued at RM2.82 billion.
Malaysia is taking steps to broaden its international trade and technology collaborations, with plans to sign a semiconductor agreement with Brazil and initiate tech-focused talks with India. Deputy Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Liew Chin Tong announced these initiatives as part of the country's strategy to strengthen ties with developing economies, particularly BRICS nations and African countries.
The government is also prioritizing the reinforcement of regional supply chains, especially in the semiconductor sector, to enhance Malaysia's economic resilience. Additionally, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is scheduled to visit Africa in November to further expand economic engagements, as Malaysia seeks to reduce its dependence on traditional markets like the United States.

title: It is evident that many people are not very familiar with the acquisition regulations.
author: siawmc
body:
It is evident that many people are not very familiar with the acquisition regulations.
Those who are rushing to sell now have actually fallen into the acquirer's trap.
My perspective:
The current acquisition price is so low that many are incurring losses. In fact, there is no urgency to sell because
If more than 75% of shareholders agree, it will compel other shareholders to decide whether to sell. If the ownership exceeds 90%, the company will still pay RM2.35 per share—so why rush to sell now? Assuming they fail to acquire enough shares, they will likely try to secure more votes, and one way to do that is by raising the acquisition price further. Those selling now will miss this opportunity.
I am simply waiting, and there is absolutely no loss for me.

body:
Genting’s Full Acquisition Offer Lacks Appeal Genting Malaysia's Maximum Valuation Reaches RM3.28 per Share Genting $GENTING (3182.MY)$ Offering RM2.35 per share, fully acquiring and privatizing Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ The plan has sparked heated market discussions, with analysts holding divergent views. Some investment banks believe that the aforementioned offer does not take into account three major future benefits for Genting Malaysia, and its share price could potentially rise to MYR 3.28 at most. Genting needs to significantly increase its offer price to be fair; hence, shareholders are advised to reject the offer. Maybank Investment Bank analysts pointed out that although the offer price of MYR 2.35 per share is 21% higher than his previous target price of MYR 1.95 for Genting Malaysia, and 10% higher than yesterday's closing price of MYR 2.14, he believes that this offer does not truly reflect the value of Genting Malaysia. "Genting Malaysia has three potential benefits that may significantly increase its fair share price in the future, which are not reflected in the offer price of MYR 2.35 per share." First, the analyst stated that the value of the land in Miami acquired by Genting Malaysia in 2022 is expected to surge after revaluation. "Currently, we value the land based on the acquisition cost of USD 422 million (approximately MYR 1.78 billion). However, in 2023, Genting Malaysia planned to sell the land for USD 1.2 billion (approximately MYR 5.07 billion). Assuming the value of the land is reassessed at USD 1.2 billion, our fair price for the stock would increase by MYR 0.55 per share." Secondly, he noted that Empire Resort, a subsidiary of Genting Malaysia, might sell its non-gaming assets to Sullivan County's local development authority for resort facilities, which would add MYR 0.30 to its fair share price. Finally, the analyst pointed out that Genting Malaysia has a good chance of winning the casino license in New York's lower state, adding at least an additional MYR 0.48 to its fair valuation. "Therefore, under the best scenario, the fair price for Genting Malaysia could reach as high as MYR 3.28 per share. We believe that shareholders of Genting Malaysia should not accept this offer." Currently, the analyst has raised the target price for Genting Malaysia from the previous MYR 1.95 to MYR 2.97, and upgraded the rating from 'Hold' to 'Buy'."
Little chance of a price increase in the purchase offer. Additionally, analysts from DA Securities agree that Genting's full takeover offer lacks attractiveness. However, they believe it is unlikely that Genting will raise its bid. The likelihood of Genting raising its offer is low, as the board of Genting Malaysia has no need to seek additional competitive acquisition proposals. Therefore, this offer may not receive sufficient support, and Genting Malaysia may ultimately fail to be privatized and delisted. He added that, for Genting, privatizing Genting Malaysia is not necessarily the best option. We believe that privatizing Genting Malaysia is not a good idea because the securities market is crucial for its future financing activities, especially if Genting Malaysia wins the New York downstate casino license and plans to allocate USD 5.5 billion (approximately MYR 23.23 billion) for development. The analyst also recommended shareholders reject Genting’s offer.
Galaxy International: A good exit opportunity However, analysts at Galaxy International Securities hold a different view, suggesting that shareholders should accept the offer since Genting's bid is higher than their target price of MYR 1.88, providing shareholders with a decent exit opportunity. Moreover, should Genting Malaysia win the New York downstate casino license, it will need to allocate more working capital and capital expenditures, leading to a decline in earnings growth and reduced dividend payouts. In any case, he noted that many shareholders who have invested in Genting Malaysia might still be facing paper losses. Furthermore, given that the offer price reflects less than a 10% premium over the current share price, it may not garner enough shareholder support, resulting in the privatization attempt failing. Investors may also wait for the results of New York State’s casino license decision, which is expected to be announced on December 1st this year. Genting Malaysia once surged by 10% Shares of Genting Malaysia, which received a voluntary general offer from its parent company, surged as much as 10% at the opening today, reaching RM2.36, even surpassing the offer price of RM2.35 per share. As for Genting, as the acquiring party, its share price rose by up to 7% this morning, reaching RM3.06. Yesterday, major shareholder Genting issued a conditional voluntary general offer to acquire all remaining shares of Genting Malaysia at RM2.35 per share, or a total consideration of RM6.744 billion, followed by plans to privatize and delist the company. Currently, Genting holds 2,797,701,859 shares of Genting Malaysia, equivalent to 49.36% of the equity interest. Genting now plans to acquire the remaining 2,870,039,874 shares, representing 50.64% of the equity, with the transaction expected to be completed by the end of the fourth quarter of 2025.
Most investors bought at higher levels
Some investment banks believe that Genting's offer of RM2.35 per share for the full acquisition and privatization of Genting Malaysia may be difficult to materialize, but it could further increase its stake.
Analysts at Galaxy International Securities noted that the above offer should increase Genting’s stake in Genting Malaysia to over 49.4%, but the privatization plan is likely to fail, given that many shareholders who have invested in Genting Malaysia are still in a loss-making position on paper.
Most shareholders of Genting Malaysia may still face book losses, as the offer price of 2.35 ringgit remains below the stock's trading range of 2.50 to 3 ringgit between 2022 and 2024.
However, the analyst stated that if the privatization is successful, he will remove the 30% parent company stake discount applied in valuing Genting, implying a significant increase in Genting's target price at that time.
Genting's valuation is considered undervalued, as its 53% stake in Genting Singapore is currently valued 26% lower in Genting's books compared to Genting Singapore's market capitalization.
For now, he maintains a 'Buy' rating on Genting with a target price of 3.57 ringgit.
Genting's Earnings Expected to Surge by 51%
Additionally, an analyst from Maybank Investment Bank noted that privatizing Genting Malaysia could bring approximately 6.3 billion ringgit in new debt to Genting, which would initially offset additional earnings contributed by fully consolidating Genting Malaysia. However, in the long term, it presents significant upside potential for Genting.
The revaluation of land in Miami, potential divestment plans for non-gaming assets of Empire Resorts, and the possibility of securing a casino license in New York's Lower Hudson Valley are all major potential catalysts brought by Genting Malaysia.
If the privatization succeeds, the analyst said that Genting’s earnings could surge by 51% or more, with fair value per share potentially rising to 4.25 ringgit.
Currently, the analyst has maintained Genting's 'Buy' rating while raising its target price from 3.70 ringgit to 3.94 ringgit.

title: Titan Trading Notes For Wednesday [15/10/2025]:
author: Titan Capital
body:
fell back towards the 1611 points region with an overall negative market sentiment as we saw over 800 counters closing red for the day. Daily trading volume remains average around the 3.6 billion mark, dominated by sellers.
Main stocks that showed strong buying momentum would be the likes of GENM, TANCO, GENTING, SCIB, CHEEDING, MCLEAN, ECOSHOP, MRDIY, AXREIT, and 99SMART. All of which were able to sustain their rallies throughout the day on the top volumes list.
$GENM(4715.MY)$ following $GENTING(3182.MY)$ privatisation offer, gapped up in the morning and maintained around the RM 2.32 - RM 2.35 region as the offer from the buyer was RM 2.35.
Expecting for it to be trading within this range, as GENTING already holds almost 50% of GENM, the privatisation offer will likely go through in my opinion, so for those of you that are trapped from higher prices from before, may have to consider to take the loss and just move on.
Can monitor GENM closely to earn the difference if suddenly have some dips below RM 2.30 as offer to buy is RM 2.35.
I don't have much to say for the rest as I expect the market to be quite volatile and shaky in the coming weeks as the tug of war between US and China intensifies. Both will do what they can to pressure each other to come to their terms before making a deal.
Will be monitoring closely, and expect tech counters with high PE multiples to be the most vulnerable to suffer from profit taking activities.
Local consumer counters shouldn't be too affected by this, which is why we saw $MRDIY(5296.MY)$ , $99SMART(5326.MY)$ , and $ECOSHOP(5337.MY)$ perform quite well today.
Defensive counters like banking and plantation should also fare pretty well.

author: siawmc
body:
An excellent question, this is a crucial proportion concept in the context of Malaysian listed company acquisitions (takeovers).
Let us explain step by step:

---

1. The significance of holding 50% + 1 share

Under Malaysian corporate law (and in most common law jurisdictions):

50% + 1 share represents obtaining a controlling interest in the company.

This means you hold the majority votes at shareholder meetings (ordinary resolution) and can:

Appoint or remove directors;

Control the company's day-to-day operational decisions;

Pass ordinary shareholder resolutions (e.g., approving financial statements, dividend distribution, etc.).

Therefore:

> ✅ Acquiring more than 50% of the equity = Gaining control of the company.

---

? Second, why is 75% also important?

75% represents another critical threshold, primarily concerning "special resolutions."

Only when shareholders hold ≥75% of the equity can they:

Amend the company’s articles of association (constitution / M&A);

Approve significant asset disposals (major disposal);

Approve privatization proposals for the company;

Execute matters requiring special resolutions such as capital restructuring, capital reduction, and mergers and acquisitions.

> ✅ Acquiring more than 50% of the equity = Gaining control of the company.
? Second, why is 75% also important?
75% represents another critical threshold, primarily concerning "special resolutions."
Only when shareholders hold ≥75% of the equity can they:
Amend the company’s articles of association (constitution / M&A);
Approve significant asset disposals (major disposal);
Approve privatization proposals for the company;
Execute matters requiring special resolutions such as capital restructuring, capital reduction, and mergers and acquisitions.

- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
$S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ 6,671.06（+0.40%)
$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ 46,253.31 (-0.04%)
$Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ 22,670.08 (+0.66%)
U.S. stocks climbed Wednesday, with AMD, Bank of America, and Morgan Stanley lifting the Nasdaq and S&P 500. Strong Q3 results buoyed $Bank of America (BAC.US)$ and $Morgan Stanley (MS.US)$, while $Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.US)$ surged after an $HSBC Holdings (HSBC.US)$ price‑target hike and has rallied sharply since early October on AI deals with Oracle and OpenAI.
Those gains offset nerves over escalating U.S.–China trade frictions—dueling port fees and China's new rare‑earth export controls—alongside U.S. threats of sweeping tariffs and a proposed ban on Chinese cooking‑oil imports.
Fed governor Stephen Miran warned downside risks have grown, calling tit‑for‑tat trade actions a new tail risk. Trump said the US is already in a trade war, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested extending the pause on high China tariffs to ease a minerals dispute.
With the US government shutdown dragging on, haven demand spiked, sending gold and silver to fresh records near $4,235 and $52.57.
Bursa Market Insight
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ 1611.550 (+0.01%)
Top Gainer: $99SMART (5326.MY)$ RM3.14 (+3.63%)
Top Loser: $QL (7084.MY)$ RM4.29 (-2.50%)
USD/MYR: $USD/MYR (USDMYR.FX)$ 4.2287(+0.08%)
The FBM KLCI closed marginally higher on Wednesday, ending its recent downward trend. The index inched up 0.09 points to 1,611.55, moving within a range of 1,611.12 to 1,619.58. Despite the benchmark's flat performance, the broader market showed signs of improvement, with gainers outnumbering losers 726 to 426.
Trading volume reached 4.26 billion shares, valued at RM3.7 billion. The KLCI's 30 component stocks were evenly split, with 13 rising, 13 falling, and 4 unchanged.
Malaysia's Investment, Trade and Industry Minister, Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, announced plans for discussions with US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick regarding sectoral tariffs, particularly in the semiconductor industry.
The talks, scheduled during the upcoming ASEAN Leaders Summit, aim to finalize a reciprocal trade agreement between the two nations. While current tariffs affect sectors like automotive, iron, steel, and furniture, semiconductors remain untouched.
The minister emphasized that negotiations will prioritize benefits for local companies and maintain previously agreed-upon protections for sensitive issues such as Bumiputera rights and the halal sector.
Malaysia's medical device industry saw a 31% export increase to RM37 billion in 2024, attracting RM20 billion in investments over four years. The sector created 130,000 high-skilled jobs and contributes RM1.8 billion annually to GDP.
To further boost growth, the government launched IMDEC 2026 and the MedTechPreneur 1.0 Programme, initiatives designed to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in medical technology.

Market observers and analysts are debating the growth outlook of Shopee versus the company’s currently high valuation. The stock now trades at a price-to-earnings ratio of approximately 94, a level that suggests even modest profit expectations are fully priced in.

The company is now among the final contenders, including Hard Rock and Bally's, following MGM's withdrawal. The state is expected to award a limited number of full-scale commercial licenses by December 1, 2025.

$COASTAL (5071.MY)$' subsidiary Elite Point has secured a new liftboat charter agreement, ensuring continued revenue from its offshore services division.

The Home Ministry has extended $NEXG (5216.MY)$'s contract to produce foreign worker identification cards, allowing the company to continue its role in Malaysia's immigration management system.

title: KUALA LUMPUR: Genting Bhd acquired 27.1 million shares in Genting Malaysia Bhd on October 15 at RM2.33 per share, two days after launching its RM6.74 billion
author: siawmc
body:
KUALA LUMPUR: Genting Bhd acquired 27.1 million shares in Genting Malaysia Bhd on October 15 at RM2.33 per share, two days after launching its RM6.74 billion conditional voluntary takeover offer to buy out minority shareholders.

Only 27 million shares over two days, and today’s trading volume is even lower; the likelihood of privatization failing is quite high.
I just had a thought—whether or not the privatization succeeds may not be crucial for Mr. Lim. The most important thing is to secure 50% control, which would give him an advantage in certain decision-making processes. We will wait and see if my prediction turns out to be correct.

body:
You are mistaken in thinking this way. No one conducting an acquisition would sweep the market on the first day, especially when they are already the largest shareholder. If he were to purchase shares at 2.34 or 2.35, retail investors or even large institutions could push the price up to 2.36 or 2.37, which could also destabilize the warrant price within minutes.

Those in the know understand that he is currently executing a sophisticated strategy. He has set the acquisition price at 2.35 but is not buying directly; instead, he is creating an ask wall. Retail investors gradually help him build this wall, and eventually, he will acquire shares at prices ranging from 2.30 to 2.33. For the prices of 2.34 and 2.35, he waits until the wall accumulates substantial volume before making his move. In reality, there is no need to be swayed by media narratives suggesting that retail investors can achieve success by uniting 50% of shareholders. On the surface, it appears to be 50%, as none of the individuals within the Board of Directors have audited their shares. Simply attending a BOD meeting requires holding 1-5% of shares. As long as he secures the support of the veteran members of the BOD and gathers a few additional scattered votes, his position will be secured. One might assume that the BOD members would object, but in fact, local major players have been acquiring shares over the past few months during GENT’s upward trend. To put it simply, the BOD is also part of this strategic setup.

body:
Stop being naive. Most of you GENM shareholders are retail investors who have been born into privilege and are like discontented leeks. You keep talking about having casinos in the U.S., land, and permits, but you dare not face the fact that obtaining a permit means spending $6.5 billion USD immediately for development, and GENUS is just a long-term pit that GENT has to fill. Every year, GENT has to either inject money or borrow to help subsidize GenUS, and the dividends you receive are essentially a father supporting his son's business at a loss.

So don't be overly optimistic. If the privatization fails, do you really think GENM will be in a good position? GENM will collapse directly because it won’t be able to secure the USD 6.5 billion promised to the NYC government within two months to develop this project. And that's not even the most absurd part. When Uncle Lim dumps his shares, you’ll feel the impact—Berjaya’s SPTOTO is a good example. Back then, everyone opposed it, saying it was too cheap. Now look at them, are they happy? You need to remember that most of GENM's assets are illiquid and cannot be quickly monetized or used as collateral—nobody wants them. (Issues are entangled with Catskill, Miami land, Genting Highlands, RWLV, etc.)

Credit Impact: Negative for Genting, Positive for GENM CreditSights viewed the move as credit negative for Genting Berhad, estimating that the group's net leverage will rise from 2.9x to 3.8–3.9x following the debt-funded acquisition
The analysts warned that the deal could "worsen refinancing risk" ahead of Genting's US$1.5 billion bond due January 2027, narrowing rating headroom with agencies such as Moody's and Fitch. However, the research house said the transaction is modestly credit positive for Genting Malaysia, as a stronger parent stake may mean greater financial support from Genting Berhad for its expansion projects, particularly the New York casino bid. "While delisting may reduce transparency and regulatory oversight, we see the benefits of stronger parental backing outweighing those drawbacks," the report stated. Ratings Outlook Remains Stable Both Genting and Genting Malaysia are expected to retain their investment-grade ratings in the near term. Genting is rated Baa2/BBB/BBB- by Moody's, Fitch, and S&P, while GENM holds BBB-/BBB ratings at S&P and Fitch. CreditSights said a one-notch downgrade risk exists due to weaker credit metrics, though a rebound in earnings from Singapore, the UK, and Las Vegas operations should help cushion the impact.

Market is split on Genting’s bold move — here’s how the top analysts see it Note: The following content is exclusive to STR Elite Subscribers On 14 Oct 2025, Maybank Investment Bank’s Yin Shao Yang upgraded GENM to Buy from Hold and raised his target price to RM2.97 from RM1.95. At its closing price of RM2.33 on 16 Oct, this implies an upside potential of 27.5%. Yin advised shareholders not to accept the offer, arguing that the proposed price undervalues GENM’s latent catalysts that could unlock substantial long-term value. Miami Land Revaluation – GENM acquired the land in 2011 for USD442 million, but sought to sell it for USD1.2 billion in 2023. A revaluation could add 55 sen to fair value (FV). However, he believes outright privatisation is unlikely, as most GENM shareholders are still sitting on paper losses — given that the RM2.35 offer is below the RM2.50–3.00 range seen between 2022 and 2024.

title: Lim Kok Thay has been aggressively purchasing shares at low prices and now controls over 50% of Genting Malaysia.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
(Kuala Lumpur, 17th report) Genting $GENTING (3182.MY)$ after launching a full takeover offer, has increased its stake in Genting Malaysia through open market purchases for two consecutive days at prices below the offer price of MYR 2.35, $GENM (4715.MY)$ with the current shareholding exceeding 50%.
According to the equity change announcement, Genting purchased a total of 36.1 million shares of Genting Malaysia on Tuesday (14th) and Wednesday (15th), increasing its stake from 49.36% to 50.02%.
The announcement disclosed that Genting made three separate purchases on Tuesday at MYR 2.31, MYR 2.32, and MYR 2.33 per share, acquiring 500,000 shares, 8 million shares, and 500,000 shares of Genting Malaysia in the open market, completing a total transaction of 9 million shares.
The following day, Genting completed the transaction of 27.1 million shares at a price of RM2.33 per share.
Genting announced on Monday (the 13th) that it would acquire the remaining shares it does not hold at RM2.35 per share or a total of RM6.7446 billion to advance the privatization process and delist from the stock exchange.
At that time, Genting held 49.36% of Genting Malaysia's equity.
Stimulated by the full acquisition announcement, Genting Malaysia's share price rose to RM2.36 upon resumption of trading on Tuesday, surpassing the offer price. However, in subsequent trading sessions, it mainly fluctuated between RM2.32 and RM2.34.
After announcing the full acquisition, Genting issued media announcements by noon the following day whenever there were trading activities concerning Genting Malaysia. However, as of 5:00 PM on Friday, no announcement regarding Thursday’s trades had been made.

title: The Must-Know Weekly Top Traded Stocks by Malaysians on Moomoo
author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Last week, macro events drove market performance. Loan fraud cases disclosed by two US regional banks sparked concerns about the credit market. Combined with the ongoing US government shutdown and the recurring US-China trade conflict, panic spread, leading to a rush into safe-haven assets.$XAU/USD (XAUUSD.CFD)$ set a record high of $4,380 last week, with gold rising 6% on a weekly basis. The crypto market saw a decline, with $Bitcoin (BTC.CC)$ briefly falling below $104,000.
On Friday, Trump's moderate comments on US-China trade boosted a rebound in US stocks. The $S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ finished the week up 1.70%, the $Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ rose 2.14%, and the $Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ gained 1.56%. Last week also marked the official start of the Q3 earnings season for US stocks, with major banks like $JPMorgan (JPM.US)$ and $Citigroup (C.US)$ reporting better-than-expected results. Attention this week will be on the earnings releases from tech stocks such as $Tesla (TSLA.US)$ .
Malaysia's economy demonstrated remarkable resilience, expanding by a surprising 5.2% in 25Q3, a figure that comfortably surpassed expectations. This robust growth, primarily fueled by strong domestic demand, a recovering tourism sector, and a rebound in mining output, has prompted several major research houses to revise their full-year economic forecasts upwards. Despite the improved immediate outlook, analysts express caution for 2026, pointing to potential external headwinds and the adverse effects of US trade tariffs on Malaysian exports. The $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ Index fell 0.93% last week to close at 1,607 points, as market volatility persisted.
US and Bursa stocks trading heat lists
Based on last week's trading data from moomoo MY, let's see which U.S. and Bursa stocks have seen a sustained increase in trading activity over the past week.
Nvidia launched the first Blackwell wafer produced in the US
$NVIDIA (NVDA.US)$ 's stock experienced minor weekly fluctuations. Last week, Nvidia launched the first Nvidia Blackwell wafer produced in the US, signaling that the Nvidia Blackwell AI chip is about to be mass-produced in the US and highlighting the core position of US domestic manufacturing in AI infrastructure.
After AMD announced a strategic cooperation with OpenAI, its $Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.US)$ Instinct series GPUs also received a large order from Oracle. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure will purchase the AMD Instinct MI450 series GPUs, with an initial plan to deploy 50,000 units starting in the third quarter of next year and plans to further expand in 2027 and beyond. AMD's stock rose 8.46% for the week. However, Oracle's stock fell 6.93% for the week, marking its worst single-day performance since January this year. After the market questioned the feasibility, there was a concentrated sell-off.
Despite reports that US memory chip giant Micron Technology plans to exit its data center server chip business in China, its stock still rose 11.44% for the week. The company will continue to supply two Chinese customers with significant data center operations outside of China.
Tesla's sales in China continue to grow
$Tesla (TSLA.US)$ 's stock rebounded 6.24% last week and announced its weekly sales in China. The company's steady growth in China is still ongoing. From October 6 to October 12, Tesla recorded 113,000 new insurance registrations in China, a figure that marks a 126% increase in sales compared to the previous week and also indicates a 33% year-over-year growth in the region compared to the same period last year. However, sales in Europe have declined. The market remains closely focused on Musk's trillion-dollar compensation plan. Tesla's Q3 FY2025 earnings, to be released after the market close on October 22, will be an important factor affecting its stock price movement.
The trading enthusiasm for the rare earth sector is gradually waning
Against the backdrop of China's rare earth export controls, the upward momentum of the rare earth sector after the surge is gradually declining. Some rare earth stocks in the US market have ended their consecutive upward trend. $MP Materials (MP.US)$ rose only 3.13% for the week, CRML rose 39.25%, and USAR fell 14.96%.
$Amazon (AMZN.US)$ is also one of the most actively traded individual stocks, but its stock has fallen for four consecutive weeks. Previously, Amazon announced the expansion of its pay-per-use telemedicine service platform, Amazon One Medical, allowing for pay-per-use access to treatment services for common childhood illnesses.

Let's also take a look at which Bursa stocks were active over the past week.
Genting's Conditional Voluntary Takeover Offer
$GENTING (3182.MY)$ has launched a conditional voluntary takeover offer to acquire the remaining 50.64% stake in its subsidiary, Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ , for MYR 2.35 per share, valuing the deal at MYR 6.74 billion. The parent company aims to delist Genting Malaysia, which owns Resorts World Genting and Resorts World New York City. A key reason for the move is to better support Genting Malaysia's bid for a New York casino license, which involves a proposed US$5.5 billion integrated resort.
If successful, Genting Berhad believes its strengthened control will enhance the subsidiary's financial capacity for this major project. The offer represents a significant premium to recent share prices. Following the announcement, Nomura analysts upgraded Genting Malaysia to a "Buy" rating. Shares of Genting Berhad and GENM rose 17.83% and 9.35% last week.
99 Speed Mart on Strong Growth Outlook
99 Speed Mart $99SMART (5326.MY)$ Retail is the prime beneficiary of Malaysia's expanding government cash-aid. With its wide store network and appeal to price-sensitive consumers, it is well-positioned to capture demand from lower-income groups. Outlet expansion and its role as a major Nestle distributor are expected to sustain a 15% earnings growth. RHB raises the stock's target price to MYR3.56 from MYR2.81, maintaining a Buy rating.
Weekend stock events
Over the weekend, US President Trump met with Ukrainian President Zelensky and made statements on issues such as US supply of "Tomahawk" missiles to Ukraine. On interest rate cuts, Musalem of the Federal Reserve indicated that if employment faces more risks and inflation is under control, he may support the path of further interest rate cuts.
Meanwhile, after last week's continued gains, gold prices experienced selling pressure, with spot gold prices briefly falling below $4,200 per ounce.
Key stock events of this week
The coming week will be the earnings season, with companies such as $Netflix (NFLX.US)$ and $Tesla (TSLA.US)$ set to release their results. $General Motors (GM.US)$ is scheduled to report earnings on Tuesday. After warning that changes in US policy may affect profits, the company may elaborate on its manufacturing business adjustment plans. $Netflix (NFLX.US)$ is also set to report earnings on Tuesday.
Tesla is scheduled to report earnings on Wednesday, with the company expected to report revenue of $26.58 billion and an estimated EPS of around $0.44, down 29.52% year-over-year.

$Intel (INTC.US)$ is set to report earnings on Thursday. UBS expects the company's results to meet expectations, with the recent strength in the personal computer and server markets laying the foundation for a slight upward revision to fourth-quarter guidance.
With the US government shutdown continuing, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report for September will be released on Friday. Market participants are almost unanimously expecting the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates by another 25 basis points at its meeting on October 28–29, especially given the Fed’s indication that it is about to end its quantitative tightening plan. For the rate cut expectation to change, the upcoming CPI data would need to show inflation pressures far exceeding expectations.

title: Financial Sector Leads Foreign Outflows as Local Institutions Boost Buying in Malaysian Market
author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Global markets tread water amid a U.S. government shutdown, but Asia's fund flows reveal a stark divide—while India and Korea attract capital, Malaysia faces relentless foreign selling.
Market Pulse
Global markets traded cautiously last week amid a halted U.S. government shutdown and Argentina's $20b currency swap lifeline. Of 20 tracked indices, 10 closed higher—South Korea's KOSPI (+3.83%) and France's CAC 40 (+3.24%) led gains, while Indonesia's JCI (-4.14%) and Hong Kong's Hang Seng (-3.97%) lagged. Brent crude fell -2.3%, and the Ringgit weakened slightly to RM4.2265/USD. With major economic data delayed, investors leaned into regional resilience.
Asia's Money Moves
